species.name: Crappie
why: Water 51°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–26 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: White bass
why: Water 51°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.

West wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the east shore: try the wind-blown banks.
